final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat,'(none)') AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat,'(none)')), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM g WHERE avg_mod IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_mod, b.baseline FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS kept_mean FROM k) SELECT k.status, k.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, k.avg_mod - k.baseline AS above_baseline, k.avg_mod - km.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k, km
